newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton trade shut for Gandhi anniversary.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton trade shut for Gandhi anniversary.

text.p: Indian cotton markets were closed on Wednesday to mark the birth anniversary of Mahatma Gandhi and will reopen on Thursday, dealers said.
On Tuesdsy, prices fell triggered by rising new crop arrivals and low demand, dealers said.

In spot deals Gujarat Kalyan fell by 300/400 rupees to 13,200/13,400 rupees per candy (355.56 kg). Bengal-deshi ready delivery eased by 5/10 rupees to 840/860 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while November delivery fell by 20 to 880/900 rupees.
